title: Active Directory with LDAP to SCIM Provisioning Migration Guide

blocks.text: This guide contains information on how to migrate from Active Directory (AD) with LDAP user synchronization to SCIM provisioning in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Make sure the following prerequisites are met:

blocks.item: Set the repository type to Active Directory in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Use SAML for authentication and AD for provisioning.
Ensure that the AD is syncing the database to Zscaler and the identity provider (IdP).

blocks.text: When migrating from AD to SCIM, do not change the database type in the Zscaler Admin Console from Active Directory to Hosted DB. Doing so can cause all existing user and group mappings to be deleted and creates duplicate users with SCIM provisioning.
To migrate from AD to SCIM provisioning:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet Authentication Settings > Default Settings.
Click Sync Now to perform a manual sync with the AD; this ensures that the Zscaler service has the latest database from the AD.
See image.
(Optional) Ensure that you have the latest user data from the AD in your IdP application by performing a manual sync in the IdP application.
Enable Disable Directory Sync & Enable SCIM Provisioning.
See image.
Click Save and activate the change.
Go to the Identity Providers tab and click the Edit icon of the IdP you plan to use.
In the Provisioning Options section, click Enable SCIM Provisioning and copy the Base URL and Bearer Token as you need them when configuring SCIM in your IdP application.
See image
Zscaler recommends that you disable Enable SAML Auto-Provisioning when using SCIM provisioning.
Using the information you copied, configure SCIM provisioning in your selected IdP application.
After the IdP is configured, ensure that users syncing from the IdP match those on the Users page in the Zscaler Admin Console.
User Management in the Zscaler Admin Console remains read-only because the User Repository Type is set to Active Directory.

blocks.text: Make sure that you do not disable the Disable Directory Sync & Enable SCIM Provisioning option or change the repository types. If you are using Zscaler Authentication Bridge (ZAB), it is safe to disable the ZAB VM if there are no provisioning issues observed after a few days.
If you need to revert from SCIM to AD provisioning:

blocks.item: Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet Authentication Settings > Identity Providers, and click the Edit icon for the IdP you used.
Disable the Enable SCIM Provisioning option.
Go to the Default Settings tab and disable the Disable Directory Sync & Enable SCIM Provisioning option.
In the IdP application that you previously configured SCIM for, disable the SCIM configuration.
Go to Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet Authentication Settings > Default Settings, and click Sync Now.
